## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

The order listing should honor the issue’s zero-limit requirement so callers can retrieve all orders.

## Changes

The pull request adds limit and offset parameters to the newest-first order listing, delegates slicing to a pagination helper, and adds tests for both entry points.

## Critical

(none)

## Important

- app/orders.py:9 — correctness — Treat a zero order limit as unlimited — `list_orders(orders, limit=0)` returns an empty page for any nonempty order list because `paginate` slices from zero to zero. Issue fixture/fixture#12 requires “limit=0 means no limit: return every order.” — Callers using `limit=0` see no orders even when the account has orders. — Fix: Translate zero to `None` before calling `paginate` and extend `test_limit_caps_results` to cover zero.
